title: Tooltip configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.TooltipAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsHover.description: Opens on mouse hover on desktop and on click on touch devices; when false it opens on click or keyboard focus.

Position.description: Placement of the balloon relative to the trigger (GlobalEnum.Position).

StartVisible.description: Shows the tooltip as soon as it is built.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
